I am a Research Fellow in the Human Rights Research Division at the Korea Institute for National Unification (KINU), a government-affiliated research institute in Seoul. My research focuses on unification policy, Cold War intellectual history, and the global conceptual history of liberal democracy. I also teach a graduate seminar on nineteenth-century European political thought.

## Research interests

- Unification policy
- Cold War intellectual history
- Global conceptual history (liberal democracy)
